label: История
description: A 10-sentence usage card for история (history; story).

missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Nominative predicate. 'История' is in the nominative as the predicate noun. 'Интересная' is the agreeing feminine adjective, intensified by 'очень'. A natural reaction to a tale.
Strategic focus: Accusative direct object. 'Историю' is the accusative object of 'люблю', the feminine ending shifting to -ю. 'России' is genitive, specifying which history.
Strategic focus: Genitive of possession. 'Истории' is genitive after 'у' to mark whose ending it is. 'Этой' agrees in feminine genitive, and 'счастливый конец' is the nominative subject.
Strategic focus: Dative after a preposition. 'Истории' is dative because 'благодаря' governs that case, expressing thanks to history. 'Прошлое' is the accusative thing we know.
Strategic focus: Instrumental after a verb. 'Историей' is instrumental because 'увлекаться' governs that case. 'Древней' agrees in feminine instrumental, expressing a hobby or passion.
Strategic focus: Prepositional case. 'Об истории' uses the prepositional form after 'об' to mark the topic. 'Этой' agrees in feminine prepositional, naming the story discussed.
Strategic focus: Accusative direct object. 'Историю' is the accusative object of 'расскажи'. 'Эту' agrees in feminine accusative, and 'мне' is the dative recipient. A common request.
Strategic focus: Accusative plural object. 'Истории' is the accusative plural, identical to the nominative for inanimate nouns. 'Старые' agrees in plural, and 'бабушка' is the subject.
Strategic focus: Genitive plural after a quantifier. 'Историй' is the genitive plural with a zero ending because 'много' governs that case. 'Интересных' agrees in genitive plural.
Strategic focus: Nominative subject. 'История' is the nominative subject of 'повторяется'. The reflexive verb agrees in feminine, and 'снова и снова' stresses the repetition. A common saying.
